name: com.vatpipeline.core
description: Bakes skinned characters to Vertex Animation Textures for GPU-instanced crowds. Includes a portable exporter (glb + PNG data textures + a decode spec) for engines that cannot consume Unity shaders, plus verification and benchmarking tools.

samples.description: The one file a host project writes: asset paths, menu items, and the hook that rewires a baked prefab's own components.
